m: तद् (nom. and acc. sg. n. of and base in comp. for 2. त from which latter all the cases of this pron. are formed except nom. sg. m. सस् or स & f. सा; instr. pl. तैस्, AV. &c.; Ved. तेभिस्, RV.; AV. &c.) m. he f. she n. it, that, this (often correlative of य generally standing in the preceding clause, e.g. यस्य बुद्धिः स बलवान्, ‘of whom there is intellect he is strong’; sometimes, for the sake of emphasis, connected with the 1st and 2nd personal pronouns, with other demonstratives and with relatives, e.g. सो ऽहम्, ‘I that very person, I myself’ [तस्य = मम, Nal. xv, 10]; ताव् इमौ, ‘those very two’; तद् एतद् आख्यानम्, ‘that very tale’, AitBr. vii, 18; यत् तत् कारणम्, ‘that very reason which’, Mn. i, 11; या सा श्री, ‘that very fortune which’, MBh. vii, 427), RV. &c.
तद् (तद्) n. this world (cf. इदम्), R. vi, 102, 25
= Brahma See तत्-त्व
तद् (तद्) ind. there, in that place, thither, to that spot (correlative of यत्र or यतस्), AV.; AitBr. ii, 11; ŚBr. i, x, xiv; ChUp.
तद् ind. then, at that time, in that case (correlative of यदा, यद्, AV.; of यत्र, ŚBr. xiv; of यदि, Nal.; Bhag. &c.; of चेद्, Śak. &c.), RV. iv, 28, 1; AV. &c.
thus, in this manner, with regard to that, ix, xiii; ŚBr.; AitBr.
(तद् एतौ श्लोकौ भवतः, ‘with reference to that there are these two verses’), PraśnUp.
on that account, for that reason, therefore, consequently (sometimes correlative of यतस्, यद्, येन, ‘because’, Daś.; Pañcat.; Kathās. &c.), Mn. ix, 41; MBh. &c.
now (clause-connecting particle), AV. xv; ŚBr.; AitBr.
so also, equally, and AV. xi, xv
तद् तद् तद् this and that, various, different (e.g. तं तं देशं जगाम, ‘he went to this and that place’; तासु तासु योनिषु, ‘in different or various birth-places’, Mn. xii, 74)
तद् तद् तद् respective, BṛNārP. xiii, 88
तद् तेनैव तेनैव पथा, on quite the same path, R. iii, 50, 28

तद् यद् तद् whosoever, whichsoever, any, every (also with वा, Mn. xii, 68 [यद् वा तद् वा, ‘this or that, any’] Hariv. 5940; Dhūrtas.; Śak., Sch.; often both pronouns repeated or the interrogative pron. with चिद् added after the relative, e.g. यद्-यत् पर-वशं कर्म तत्-तद् वर्जयेत्, ‘whatever action depends on another, that he should avoid’, Mn. iv, 159; यत् किं-चिद्-तद्, ‘whatever-that’, Mn.)
तद् तन् न. See s.v. चेद्
तद् तद् ind. अपि ‘even then’, nevertheless, notwithstanding, Śak. (v.l.), Bhartṛ.; Prab.; Siṃhās.
तद् (ind.) यथा, ‘in such a manner as follows’, namely, viz. Buddh. (cf. Pāli seyyathā; स यथा-, ŚBr.); Jain. (in Prākṛt taṃ jahā; cf. sejjahā), Pat.; Śak.
तद् [cf. ὁ, ἡ, τό; Goth. sa, sō, that-a; Lat. (is-)te, (is-)ta, (is-)tud, tam, tum, tunc.]
a: तद् — pron. a. (Nom. sing. सः m., सा f., तत् n.) 1 That, referring to something not present; (तदिति परोक्षे विजानीयात्). --2 He, she, it; (oft. as corr. of यद्); यस्य बुद्धिर्बलं तस्य Pt. 1. --3 That, i. e. wellknown; सा रम्या नगरी महान्स नृपतिः सामंतचक्रं च तत् Bh. 3. 37; Ku. 5. 71. --4 That (referring to something seen or experienced before, अनुभूतार्थः); उत्कांपिनी भयपरिस्खलितांशुकांता ते लोचने प्रतिदिशं विधुरे क्षिपंती K. P. 7; Bv. 2. 5. --5 The same, identical, that, very; usually with एव; तानींद्रियाणि सकलानि तदेव नाम Bh. 2. 40. Sometimes the form of तद् are used with the first and second personal pronouns, as well as with demonstratives and relatives, for the sake of emphasis; (often translatable by ‘therefore’, ‘then’); सोहमिज्याविशुद्धात्मा R. 1. 69; ‘I that very person’, ‘I therefore’; (I who am so and so); स त्वं निवर्तस्व विहाय लज्जां 2. 40 ‘thou, therefore, shouldst return’, &c. When repeated तद् has the sense of ‘several’, ‘various’; तेषु तेषु स्थानेषु K. 369; Bg. 7. 20; Māl. 1. 36; ते ते भावाः 1. 17. तेन the instr. of तद् is often used with adverbial force in the sense of ‘therefore’, ‘on that account, in that case’, ‘for that reason.’ तेन हि if so, well then. --ind. 1 There, thither. --2 Then, in that case, at that time. --3 For that reason, therefore, consequently; तदेहि विमर्दक्षमां भूमिमवतरावः U. 5; Me. 7, 109: R. 3. 46. --4 Then (corr. of यदि); तथापि यदि महत्कुतूहलं तत्कथयामि K. 136; Bg. 1. 46. --n. 1 The Supreme Spirit or Brahman. --2 This world. --Comp. --अतिपात a. going beyond the bounds. --अनंतर a. next to that. (--ind.) immediately after that, thereupon. --अनु ind. after that, afterwards; संदेशं मे तदनु जलद श्रोष्यसि श्रोत्रपेयं Me. 13; R. 16. 87; Māl. 9. 26. --अंत a. perishing in that, ending thus. --अर्थ, --अर्थीय a. {1} intended for that. {2} having that meaning. --अर्ह a. meriting that. --अवधि ind. {1} so far, upto that period, till then; तदवधि कुशली पुराणशास्त्ररमृतिशतचारुविचारजो विवेकः Bv. 2. 14. {2} from that time, since then, श्वासो दीर्घस्तदवधि मुखे पांडिमा Bv. 2. 62. --अवस्थ a. so circumstanced. --एकाचित्त a. having the mind solely fixed on that. --कर a. serving, obeying as servant. --कालः {1} the current moment, present time. {2} that time. ˚धी a. having presence of mind. --कालं ind. {1} instantly, immediately. {2} at that time, at a certain time. --क्षणः {1} present, time be ing present or current moment; R. 1. 51. {2} the same moment. {3} a measure of time. --क्षणं, --क्षणात् ind. immediately, directly, instantly; R. 3. 14; Śi. 9. 5; Y. 2. 14; Amaru. 83. --क्रिय a. working without wages. --गत a. gone or directed to that, intent on that, devoted to that, belonging to that. --(तः) the continued multiplication of four or more like quantities. --गुण a. possessing those qualities. --(णः) {1} the quality or virtue of anything. {2} a figure of speech (in Rhet.); स्वमुत्सृज्य गुणं योगादत्युज्ज्वलगुणस्य यत् . वस्तु तद्गुणतामोति भण्यते स तु तद्गुणः K. P. 10; see Chandr. 5. 141. ˚संविज्ञानः a term applied to those Bahuvrīhi compounds in which the qualities denoted by the name are perceived along with the thing itself; as लंबकर्ण; cf. अतद्गुणसंविज्ञान also --ज a. immediate, instantaneous. --ज्ञः a knowing or intelligent man, wise man, philosopher. --तृतीय a. doing that for the third time. --धन a. miserly, niggardly. --पदार्थः the Supreme Being. --पर a. {1} following that, coming after that, inferior. {2} having that as the highest object, closely intent on, exclusively devoted to, eagerly engaged in (usually in comp.); सम्राट् समाराधनतत्परोऽभूत् R. 2. 5; 1. 66; Me. 10; Y. 1. 83; Ms. 3. 262. {3} diligent. --(रः) the thirtieth part of a twinkling of the eye. ˚ता, ˚त्वं {1} intentness, entire devotion or addiction to a thing. {2} inferiority. --परायण a. solely devoted or attached to anything. --पुरुषः {1} the original or Supreme Spirit. {2} N. of a class of compounds in which the first member determines the sense of the other member, or in which the last member is defined or qualified by the first, without losing its original independence; as तत्पुरुषः; तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येनाहं स्यां बहुव्रीहिः Udb. --पूर्व a. {1} happening or occurring for the first time; अकारि तत्पूर्वनिबद्धया तया Ku. 5. 10, 7. 30; R. 2. 42, 14. 38. {2} prior, former. --प्रथम a. doing that for the first time; Ku. 5. 66. --फल a. having that as a fruit or result. --(लः) {1} the white water-lily. {2} a kind of perfume. --बलः a kind of arrow. --भावः becoming that. --मात्रं {1} merely that, only a trifle, a very small quantity. {2} (in phil.) a subtle and primary element (such as शब्द, रस, स्पर्श, रूप and गंध). --मात्रिक a. consisting of rudimentary atoms. --राजः an affix added to some proper names to form from them the names of the ‘king’ or ‘chief’; as from अंग is formed आंग ‘king of the Aṅgas' by the affix अण्. --वाचक a. denoting or signifying that --विद् a. {1} knowing that. {2} knowing the truth. --विध a. of that kind or sort; R. 2. 22; Ku. 5. 73; Ms. 2. 112. --स्थ a. being on or in that, connected with it. --(स्थः) a particular mode of multiplication. --हित a. good for that --(तः) {1} an affix added to primary bases to form derivative or secondary bases from them {2} a noun formed by a Taddhita affix, a derivative noun.

m: तदा ind. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 15 and 19 ff.) at that time, then, in that case (often used redundantly, esp. after ततस् or पुरा or before अथ, MBh. &c.; correlative of यद् [AV. xi, 4, 4], यत्र [ChUp. vi, 8, 1], यदा [Mn.; MBh. &c.], यदि [Gīt.; Vet.; Hit.], यर्हि [BhP. i, 18, 6], यतस्, ‘since’, [MBh. xiii, 2231], चेद् [Śak. v (v.l.), Kathās. xi; Śrut.])
त˚दा-तदा then and then, Sāy. on RV. i, 25, 8
त˚दा-प्रभृति from that time forward, (correlative of यदाप्र्˚, R. iii, 17, 21; of यदा, Śak. vi, 4/5), R.; Ragh. ii, 38; Kathās. ii, 62
तर्हि तदा (correlative of यदि) then, Vet. iv, 24/25
यदा — तदा (both repeated or the verb being repeated), at any time when — then, Hit.
यदा-तदा at any time whatsoever, always, MBh. i, 6373; Naiṣ. viii, 39.
a: तदा — ind. 1 Then, at that time. --2 Then, in that case; (corr. of यदा). Bg. 2. 52-53; Ms. 1. 52, 54-56; यदा यदा-तदा तदा ‘whenever’; तदाप्रभृति ‘since then,’ ‘thenceforward;’ Ku. 1. 53. --Comp. --मुख a. begun, commenced. --(खं) beginning.

v: pu॰ nyAyaBede antaBUtasya karttavyatve SAstrataH prApte AdiBUtasyotkarzeRa viDAnaboDake nyAyaBede । sa ca nyAyaH jEmi॰ paYcamasya praTame pAde darSito yaTA । agnIzomIyapaSO SrUyate “tizWantaM paSuM prayajantIti” । atra prakftO paSumAraRAnantaraM havizyAsAdite paScAt prayAjAdaya ijyante iti vikftAvihApi paSumAraRAnantaraM havizyAsAdite prayAjAH prAptAH te ca tizWantamiti vacanAt jIvatyeva paSO apakfzyante । taTA savanIyapaSO anuyAjAnAmutkarzaH SrUyate yaTA agnilABAdUrdDvamanuyAjeScarantIti । atra saMSayaH । prayAjamAtrasyotkarzaH prayAjAdyaNgakalApasyApakarzaH anuyAjAdyaNgakalApasyotkarzo vA iti । Srutayoreva prayAjAnuyAjayorapakarzotkarzO natu tadAdyantakalApayostadaNgaprayAjA pUrvaBAvinAmAGArasAmaDenyAdInAM tadAdyapakarze'tyantavyavahitatvena praDAnakAlInatvaM na syAt prayAjamAtrApakarze tu BAsate । tAdfSaSca DarmastadvyaktitvAdirUpa eva । apUrvavyaktinizWa tAdfSaDarmasya viSezya jYAtumaSakyatve'pi ekamAtravfttimatvaM syAt evamanuyAjamAtrotkarze tadUrdDvaBAvinAM sUktavAkasampravAkAdInAmutkarzAt praDAnasanniDirna vilupyate tasmAt prayAjamAtrasyotkarzaH taTA ca sUtram “aNgAnAM muKyakAlatvAt yaToktamutkarzaH syAt” । aNgAnAM muKyakAlakarttavyatvAnuroDAt yaToktasyAnuyAjamAtrasyotkarza iti prApte brUmaH । prakftiyAge sakramapadArTAnuzWAnasya kxptatvAt vikftAvapi sakramARAM padArTAnAmatideSAt kramarUpANgavADasyAnyAyyatvAt uttarakAlakarttavyakarmapadArTasyAnupasTityAnuzWAnavilopApatteH taduktam pUrveRIpasTitaM kAryyamuttaraM karmacodanAt । prAptaM tadanyaTA BAve kramalopAdvilupyate” । tasmAt prayAjApakarze tadaNga kalApasyApakarzaH, anuyAjotkarze tadAdyaNgakalApasyotkarza”, iti tattvabO॰ । anayA diSA mAsikAnAM sakramARAM karaRe utkarzApakarzO kalpanIyO ।

m: तदा—त्व n. (opposed to आ-यति) ‘state of then’, the present time, Mn. vii; MBh. ii f., v, vii; R. v, 76, 16 and 90, 1.
a: तदात्वं — The time being, present time.

k.v: तत्कालस्तु तदात्वं स्यादुत्तरः काल आयतिः। सांदृष्टिकं फलं सद्य उदर्कः फलमुत्तरम्.।

m: तदात्व-मात्र-श्रद्धेय see श्र्˚, p. 1096.

v: pu॰ tasya BAvaH asADAraRaDarmaH prAptirvA । 1 tasyAsADAraRe Darme yaTA vawe Gawatvam । gorgotvam । 2 tadrUpaprAptO ca “aBUtatadBAve cviH” “payasastadBAvAt” kAtyA॰ SrO॰ 4 । 3 । 23 sU॰ । 7 ta॰ tasmin BAvaH tadvizayakacintane “sadA tadBAvaBAvitaH” gItA ।
m: तद्—भाव m. the becoming that, KātyŚr. iv, 3, 13; Bādar. iii, 4, 40 (अ- neg., ‘the becoming [not that i.e.] something else’)
his intentions, Kām. xi, 29; xviii, 3
तद्—भाव mfn. ifc. ‘becoming’, see अ-भूत-.
तद्—भूत mfn. being in that, Jaim. i, 1, 25.
तद्—भव mfn. = तज्ज, Mn. iv, 232, Medhāt.
तद्—भिन्न mfn. different from that.
तद्—धारण n. N. of an art, Gal.

m: तद्—धन mfn. niggardly, L.
तद्-धर्म mfn. having the same qualities, ĀpY.
तद्—धर्मन् mfn. practising that, iii, 2, 134
accomplishing his business, KātyŚr. i, 6, 12; Jaim. vi, 3, 26 (cf. ताद्धर्म्य)
तद्—धर्˚म-त्व n. the having his or its peculiarity, KapS. i, 52 (अ- neg.)
तद्—धर्मिन् mfn. obeying his laws, BhP. iii, 15, 32.

v: tri॰ sa Darmma yasya anic samA॰ । taTABUtaDarmmayukte । “AkvestacCIlatadDarmma tatsADukArizu” pA॰

m: तद्—˚धर्म्य mfn. of that kind, v, 14, 2.

v: tri॰ tasmE hitam । 1 tasmE hite । 2 vyAkaraRokte pratyayaBede puMna॰ । “tadDitAH 4 । 1 । 76 pA॰ sUtreRADikftya “yUnastiH” ityAdinA paYcamADyAyasamAptiM yAvadye pratyayA vihitAste tadDitasaMjYakAH । Sabda॰ prakA॰ tallakzaRAdikamuktaM yaTA “viBaktyAditrikAdanyaH pratyayastadDitaM matam । nAmaprakftiko nEvamativyAptyAdidozataH” । “viBaktiDAtvaMSakfdByo'nyaH pratyayastadDitaH । vfkzaka ityAdO hrasvAdyarTakaH kAdirapi tadDitameveti । tadanyatvenApi pratyayaM viSezayantyanye । nAmaprakftikapratyayatvantu na tadDitasya lakzaRaM viBaktO kyajAdO cAtivyApteH pacatitarAmityAdO tarAmAdyavyApteSca” । viBajate । “tasyApatyaM tadviSezastadfkzeRa yutendumAn । kAlastaTA tena raktaM tasya vyUho'Ta vetti tat । aDIte vA devatA'sya sEvamAdIn yaTAyaTam । voDayadviviDAnarTAMstadDitaM syAdanekaDA” tenAsya klIvatvamapi “tadDitasyAcAmAdeH” । “tadDitaScAsarvaviBaktiH” pA॰ । “samAsatadDitakftAM yatkiYcidupadarSakam । guRapraDAnaBAve ca tasya dfzwo viparyyayaH” harikArikA । sa ca tadDito dviviDaH prakftyarTaBinnArTakaH svArTikaSceti BedAt ।
m: तद्—धित n. (हित) sg. and pl. his welfare, Āp. ii; BhP. ii, 9, 7

तद्—धित m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix forming nouns from other nouns (opposed to 1. कृत्), noun formed thus, derivative noun (तद्-धित mfn. ‘good for that or him’, is one of the meanings peculiar to derivative nouns, cf. मौदकिक &c.), Nir. ii, 2; Prāt.; Pāṇ.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; PārGṛ.; Gobh. ii, 8, 15 (also अ—तद्-धित neg. mfn. ‘having no Taddhita affix’)
तद्—धित—ढुण्ढी f. N. of a gloss on the Taddhita chapter in Hemachandra's grammar by Ānandagaṇi.
तदीय mfn. (Pāṇ. i, 1, 74, Kāś.) belonging or relating to or coming from him or her or that or them, his, hers, its, theirs, MBh. viii, 675; R. iv, 21, 35; Ragh. &c.
such, Daś.; BhP. viii, 20, 33 (न तदीयम् अण्व् अपि, ‘not even as little as that, not a bit’) &c.
a: तदीय — a. Belonging to that, his, hers, its, theirs; R. 1. 81, 2. 28; 3. 8, 25.

m: तदीय—सङ्ग m. a meeting with her, Pañcat.
तद्-अहर् तद् अहर् acc. ind. on that very day, ŚBr.
तद्—अहे loc. ind. on that day, Hemac.
तदम् ind. ifc. for तद्, g. शरद्-आदि.
तद्—अनन्तर mf(आ)n. nearest to any one (gen.), Nal. xxii, 16
तद्—अनन्तरम् ind. immediately upon that, thereupon, then (corresponding to प्राक्, ‘before’, Śak. vii, 30; to प्रथमम्, ‘first’, Mn. viii, 129), MBh. &c.

v: na॰ tayorananyatvam । tayorBedABAve “tadananyatva mAramBaRaSabdAdiByaH” SA॰ sU॰ ।

m: तद्—अन्न (तद्-), mfn. accustomed to that food, RV. viii, 47, 16
eating (that i.e.) the same food, R. ii, 103, 30 and 140, 13.
तद्—अन्त (तद्-), mfn. coming to an end by that, TBr. i, 5, 9, 3; Hit.
तद्—अनु ind. after that, afterwards, Megh.; Ratnāv.; Amar.; Śrut.; Subh.
तद्—अनुकृति ind. conformably to that, accordingly, AitBr. vi, 1, 2.
तद्—अनुसरण n. going after that, Sāh. i, 2/3, 58
तद्—अनुसरण—क्रमेण ind. instr. See s.v. क्रम.
तद्—अन्वय mfn. descended from him, VP. iv, 2, 2.
तद्—अन्य mfn. other than that, L.

v: pu॰ tadanyaH bADitArTasya prasaNgaH । pramARabADitArTasya prasaNgarUpe pramARabADitArTaprasaNgAparaparyyAye tarkaBede । tatsvarUpAdi “sa cAyaM tarkaH paYcaviDaH AtmASrayAnyonyASrayacakrakAnavasTApramARavADitArTaprasaNgaBedAt iti” viBajya AtmASrayAdIn lakzayitvA jagadISenoktaM yaTA uktacatuzkAnyaH prasaNgaH pramARabADitArTaprasaNgaH । so'pi dviviDo vyAptigrAhako vizayapariSoDakaSca tatrAdyo yaTA DUmo yadi vahnivyaBicArI syAttadA janyo na syAditi । dvitIyastu parvato yadi nirvahniH syAnnirDUmaH syAdityAdi” । vizayasya vyaBicAraSaNkAnivfttidvArA niScAyakatvena pariSoDakatvam ।

m: तद्—अपस् (तद्-), mfn. accustomed to that work or to do that, RV. ii, 13, 3 and 38, 1; viii, 47, 16
तद्—अपस् ind. in the usual way, v, 47, 2.
तद्—अपत्य mfn. having offspring from him, Mn. iii, 16 (-ता f. abstr.)
तद्—अपत्य—मय mfn. thinking of one's off spring only, Subh.
तद्—अपत्य—ता f., abstr.
तद्—अपेक्ष mfn. having regard to that, Gaut.
तद्—˚अर्धिक mfn. half as much, Mn. iii, 1.
तद्—˚अर्थीय mfn. intended for that, undertaken for that end, Bhag. xvii, 27.

v: tri॰ sa arToyasya, tasmE idaM vA “arTena saha nityasamAso viSezyaniGnatA ceti” vArtti॰ samAso vA । 1 tatprayojanake 2 taduddeSyake “antevAsI vArTAMstadarTezu Darmakftyezu yojayeddAhitA vA” dAya॰ ta॰ ApastambaH । 3 tasyABiDeye 4 tatprayojane ca tato BAve zyaY । tAdarTya tatprayojanakatve । “tAdarTye caturTI” mugDa vo॰ ।
m: तद्—अर्थ mfn. intended for that, Āp. ii, 14, 3; Pāṇ. ii, 1, 36; i, 3, 72, Kāś.
serving for that, Jaim. i, 2, 1 (अ- neg.)
having that or the same meaning, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 58
तद्—अर्थ m. (its or) their meaning, Vedāntas. 200
तद्—अर्थक mf(इका)n. denoting that, Naiṣ. iv, 52.
तद्—अर्थम् ind. on that account, with that object, for that end, therefore, Pāṇ. v, 1, 12; R. i, 73, 4; VarBṛS. lxxiv, Kāś.; VP. iv
तद्—अर्थ—ता f. = तादर्थ्य, ĀśvŚr. iii, 4, 12, Sch.
तद्—अर्ह see अ-.

v: na॰ tasya svasmin nikziptasyArpaRaM pratyarpaRam । nikziptadravyasya nikzepturarpaRe । 6 ta॰ । tasyArpaRe ca ।
m: तद्—अर्पण n. delivery of that, W.
तद्—अतिपात mfn. transgressing that, W.
तद्—अवधि ind. from that time, Bhām. ii, 56
up to that period, W.
तद्—अवस्थ mfn. so situated, thus circumstanced, in that condition, MBh. iii, 69, 31; Ratnāv.
being in the same condition (as before), undamaged, iv, 19.
तद्—बहु mfn. doing that often, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.
तद्—बहुल-विहारिन् mfn. id., Divyāv. xvii, 182; 463; 482.

s: puM, (tasmin lakzye eva balaM yasya .) bARaviSezaH । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 444 ॥

m: तद्—बल, m. or तद्—ब˚ला, f. a kind of arrow, L.
तद्—बन्धु (तद्-), mfn. belonging to that family or race, RV. x, 61, 18.
तद्—दैवत mfn. = -देव्˚, Nir. vii, 1; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.
तद्—दैवत्य mf(आ)n. id., VarBṛS. ic, 3.
तद्—देश्य mfn. coming from the same country, (m.) a fellow-countryman, MBh. xii, 168, 41; Kām. xiii, 77.
तद्—देवताक mfn. id., RV. x, 18; Sāy.
तद्—देवत mfn. having that deity, KātyŚr. xxiv, 6; ĀpŚr. vii; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.
तद्—देवत्य mfn. id., Lāṭy. iv, 4, 21.

m: तद्—दिन n. that, day, W.
तद्—दिनम् ind. on a certain day, W.
during the day, W.
every day, W.
तद्—दुःख n. grief for that or of that, W.
तद्—द्वितीय mfn. doing that for the 2nd time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.
तद्—एक-चित्त mfn. having all the thoughts fixed on that (person or thing), Hit.
तद्—एवोपनिषद् f. N. of an Up. (beginning with the words तद् एव).

v: tri॰ tat gataH । 1 tatpare 2 tadAsakte ca । tadgatenEva manasA” rAmA॰ vA॰ 2 a॰ । “SucistadgatamAnasaH” gItA

ifc. intent on Vet. iv, 22
तद्—गत m. (?) the continued multiplication of 4 or more like quantities, W.

xvi
xxiii f.
the virtue of (that or) those (persons), Ragh. i, 9
(in rhet.) transferring the qualities of one thing to another (a figure of speech), Sāh. x, 90; Kuval.; Kpr. x, 51
also अ- neg. ‘a figure of speech in which a quality expected in any object is denied’, 52

v: pu॰ tatra bahuvrIhO guRasya guRIBUtasya viSezaRasya saMvijYAnaM viSezyapAratantryeRa boDanaM yatra । vyAkaraRokte bahubrIhisamAsaBede । Bavati ca lambakarRamAnayetyAdO guRIBUtasya karRasyApyAnayane pAratantryeRAnvayavoDaH । Sabda॰ pra॰ svamate tallakzaRAdikamuktvA prAcInamatasidDamapyuktaM yaTA “tadatadguRasaMvijYAnO dvO BedO tadAdimaH । vigrahasya viSezyo yastadviSezyakaboDakft” । tadguRasaMvijYAno'tadguRasaMvijYAnaSca bahuvrIherdvO BedO । tatra vigrahavAkyasya viSezyaviDayA pratyAyyoyo'rTastadviSezyakaboDakfdbahubrIhiH tayorAdimastadguRasaMvijYAnastasya svArTaguRIBUtasya samyagviviSezyaviDayA vijYAnaM yasmAditi vyutpattyA sAnvayasaMjYakatvAt । tadBinnaScAtadguRasaMvijYAnaScaramaH ityarTAdgamyate । GawasvarUpaH padArTaH ityAditohi GawaH svarUpaM yasyeti vigrahasTale svasvarUpABinnaGawasambanDitvena GawABinnasvasvarUpasambanDitvena vA vigrahaviSezyaM kalasameva viSezyaviDayA boDyate Gawasya svarUpaM yasmAditi vigrahe ca vigrahasya yadviSezyaM tato'nyadeva svajanyasvarUpABinnaGawasambanDitvena । kuwAdirgaRa ityAdirapi kuwa Adiryasyeti vyutpattyA kuwABinnasya svaDarmikavyavasTADarmiRaH sambanDitvena DAtvantaramiva kuwamapi boDayaMstadguRasaMvijYAna eva bahuvrIhiH । prAcAM matena tadguRasaMvijYAnabahubrIhimanyaTA nirvakti । “yaH svArTaGawakArTasya KArTAnvayini boDane । anukUlo bahubrIhiH sa tayoraTavAdimaH” । yo bahubrIhiH svArTasyAnvayini svArTaGawakasyApyarTasyAnvayaboDane samarTaH sa tayostadatadguRasaMvijYAnayorAdimaH । lambakarRamAnaya hAragrIvaM paSyetyAdO hi bahuvrIhirlambasvakarRasambanDinaH svagrIvAvfttihArasambanDinaSca svArTasyAnvayini karmatvAdO svArTaGawakIBUtasya tAdfSakarRahArAderapi vyutpattivEcitryeRAnvayaboDage samarTa ityevaMviDa eva tadguRasaMvijYAnastadBinna eva cArTAdatadguRasaMvijYAnaH । yaTA dfzwasAgaramAnaya ityAdAviti
m: तद्—गुण—संविज्ञान n. (a Bahuvrīhi compound) in which the qualities implied are perceived along with the thing itself (e.g. दीर्घकर्ण, ‘long-ear’; opposed to अ-, e.g. दृष्टसागर, ‘one who has seen the ocean’), Bādar. i, 1, 2, Sch.; Sarvad.
तद्—गुण—त्व n. the having its qualities, Jaim. vi, 7, 16 (अ- neg.)
तद्—इद्-आसीय n. the hymn, RV. x, 120; ŚāṅkhŚr. xi.
तद्—इद्-अर्थ mfn. intent on that particular object, RV. viii, 2, 16 (cf. ii, 39, 1; ix, 1, 5; x, 106, 1).

v: tri॰ tadeti iRa--kvip tuk । tadvizayake stotre । “vayamu tvA tadidarTAH” f॰ 8 । 2 । 16 yadvizayakaM stotraM tadit tadevArTaH prayojanaM yezAm” BA॰ ।

m: तद्—इष्टि (तद्-), mfn. accompanied by such offerings, AV. xi, 7, 19.
तद्—ओजस् (तद्-), mfn. endowed with such strength, v, 1, 8.
तद्—ओकस् (तद्-), mfn. rejoicing in that, RV. i, 15, 1; iii, 35, 7; iv, 49, 6; vii, 29, 1.

v: pu॰ tasya rAjA wac । 1 tasya nfpatO 2 tadarTavihite tadDitapratyayaBede ca । “te tadrAjAH” pA॰ te aYAdayastadrAjasaMjYakAH syuH “YyAdayastadrAjAH” pA॰ “pUgAt Yya ityAraBya uktAH tadrAjasaMjYakA syuH” si॰ kO॰ । tadrAjasya bahuzu astriyAm luk ।
m: तद्—राज m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix added to the N. of a race for forming the N. of its chief, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 62; iv, 1, 174; v, 3, 119.
तद्—रूप mf(आ)n. thus shaped, so formed, looking thus, KapS. v, 19 and Jaim. vi, 5, 3 (-त्व n. abstr.), Pañcat.; Pāṇ. vii, 3, 86, Sch.
of the same quality, Sarvad. xv, 354; Vām. iv, 3, 9 (अ- neg. ‘of different quality’)
अ-, ‘reverse’, Bādar. iii, 4, 40.
तद्—रूप—त्व n., abstr.

v: avasAde mohe ca sO॰ para॰ aka॰ sew idit । tandrati atandrIt । tandrA

m: तद्—रस m. the spirit thereof, W.
तद्रियञ्च् m(nom. ˚यङ्)fn. extending thither, TS. v, 5, 1.

v: tri॰ tadaYcati gacCati pUjayati vA--anc--gatO pUjAyAM vA kvip weradryAdeSaH pUjArTatve na nalopaH । 1 tadgAmini 2 tatpUjake ca ।
m: त˚द्र्यञ्च् mfn. id., Pāṇ. vi, 3, 92, Kāś.
तद्—वा ind. = -वत्, q.v.
तद्—वाचक mfn. signifying that,
तद्—वीर्य-विद्वस् mfn. अ- neg., not knowing his manliness, BhP. vi, 17, 10.
तद्—वश mfn. longing for that, RV. ii, 14, 2 and 37, 1.
तद्—वचः-प्रतीत mfn. believing his words.
तद्—वन् m. pl. N. of a class of Ṛṣis (cf. यद्-वन्, तर्वन्, यर्व्˚), Pat., Introd. on Vārtt. 9.
तद्—वसति mfn. dwelling there.

v: avya॰ tena tulyaM yA tulyA sA cet kriyetyarTe vati । 1 tatsadfSakriyAvati । tasyeva tatreva vA ityarTe vati । 2 tattulye'rTe yaTA tadvat Sivasya viButA, tadvat Sive BaktirityAdi । “tadvattAdfSi ca sTitam” svANgalakzaRam । “citraM yaTASrayamfte sTARvAdiByo vinA yaTA CAyA । tadvadvinA viSezErna tizWate nirASrayaM liNgam” “puruzasya mokzArTaM pravarttate tadvadavyaktam” sA॰ kA॰ । “kzattfvEdehakO tadvat prAtilomye'pi janmani” manuH । tad astyarTe matup masya vaH । 3 tadviSizwe tri॰ “tadvAnapoho vA SabdArTaH” kAvya॰ pra॰ “dravyARi tadvanti pfTaktvasaMKye” । “aTa vA tatprakAraM yajjYAnaM tadvadviSezyakam” BAzApa॰ striyAM NIp । tasya BAvaHtal । tadvattA tadviSizwatve strI “padArTe tatra tadvattA yogyatA parikIrttitA” BAzA॰ ।
m: तद्—वत् mfn. having or containing that, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. iv, 4, 125; KapS. i, v; Tarkas. &c.
तद्—वत् ind. like that, thus, so (correlative of यद्-वत्, Mn. x, 13; Bhag.; Pañcat.; of यथा, ‘as’, ŚvetUp. ii, 14 [v.l. for तद्-वा] MBh. i, vii &c.), ŚāṅkhGṛ. v, 9, 3 &c.
in like manner, likewise, also, Śrut.; Kathās. vi, xxvi
